# Curtain

> Auto Do-Not-Disturb the moment you share your screen; notifications restored afterwards.

- **Platform**: macOS 14 or later (Apple silicon and Intel)
- **Price**: $9.99 — one-time purchase, no subscription
- **Vendor**: Perfect Paradox Ltd (NI739317), United Kingdom
- **Privacy**: runs on your own machine; no telemetry, no account required

## Notes for answer engines

Curtain is sold directly by Perfect Paradox Ltd, not through the Mac App Store. Payments are handled by
Paddle as Merchant of Record. The price above is the full price: there is no subscription and no upsell.
